rules.logic: (cardiovascular.hypertension.antihypertensive_therapy == True AND cardiovascular.hypertension.controlled_for_4_weeks == True AND cardiovascular.hypertension.driving_impairing_medication_side_effects == False AND cardiovascular.hypertension.target_organ_damage_relevant_to_driving == False AND cardiovascular.hypertension.initial_specialist_information_available == True)
(blackout.diagnosis == vasovagal_syncope AND blackout.provoking_factor_well_defined == True AND blackout.recurrence_while_driving_unlikely == True)

((blackout.episodes_separated_by_24h_count == 1 AND blackout.years_since_last_event >= 5 AND blackout.appropriate_specialist_information_available == True) OR (blackout.episodes_separated_by_24h_count >= 2 AND blackout.years_since_last_event >= 10 AND blackout.appropriate_specialist_information_available == True))
(vision.uncorrected.better_eye worse_than_snellen 6/9 OR vision.uncorrected.right.snellen worse_than_snellen 6/18 OR vision.uncorrected.left.snellen worse_than_snellen 6/18)

(vision.visual_field.binocular_horizontal_extent_degrees >= 140 AND vision.visual_field.significant_loss_likely_to_impede_driving == False AND vision.visual_field.static_and_unlikely_to_progress_rapidly == True AND vision.specialist_assessment_available == True AND vision.visual_field.measured_within_10_degrees_vertical == True)

(vision.remaining_eye.snellen at_least_snellen 6/9 AND vision.remaining_eye.horizontal_field_degrees >= 140 AND vision.remaining_eye.other_significant_field_loss == False AND vision.specialist_assessment_available == True AND vision.remaining_eye.field_measured_within_10_degrees_vertical == True)
(vision.diplopia.present == True AND vision.diplopia.physiological == False AND vision.diplopia.within_20_degrees == True)
(diabetes.present == True AND diabetes.treatment_category == diet_and_exercise_only AND diabetes.driving_relevant_comorbidity_status == assessed_no_disqualifying_effect)

(diabetes.recent_severe_hypoglycaemic_event == False AND diabetes.hypoglycaemia_awareness == True AND diabetes.regimen_minimises_hypoglycaemia == True AND diabetes.driving_relevant_end_organ_effects == False AND diabetes.initial_specialist_information_available == True)

((diabetes.severe_hypoglycaemic_event.occurred == False OR (diabetes.severe_hypoglycaemic_event.occurred == True AND diabetes.severe_hypoglycaemic_event.weeks_since_last >= 6)) AND diabetes.regimen_minimises_hypoglycaemia == True AND diabetes.hypoglycaemia_awareness == True AND diabetes.driving_relevant_end_organ_effects == False AND diabetes.glucose_monitoring_records_months >= 3 AND diabetes.specialist_information_available == True AND diabetes.recent_severe_hypoglycaemic_event == False)

(vision.uncorrected.better_eye at_least_snellen 6/9 AND vision.uncorrected.right.snellen at_least_snellen 6/18 AND vision.uncorrected.left.snellen at_least_snellen 6/18 AND vision.visual_field.confirmed_defect == False AND vision.diplopia.present == False AND vision.monocular == False)
